nesnd_crisis.30.local.zh: [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_land_petition_state').GetName]的清丈官带着新法下乡勘定后，当地几处军功庄园却仍在按旧例征租。已经缴清赎价的农户被他们的“老爷”告知，所耕之田属于军籍，不许抵触租税。一些替农民代写申诉的塾师也因包庇隐产而遭拘押。\n\n涉事各县呈来的契约与军营的册籍彼此抵牾。省督要求接手复核，清丈官则请朝廷派兵收缴隐匿的文书。迁延日久，原本期待分田的农民聚集到县城，等待这个许诺解放他们的新政府作出答复。
nesnd_crisis.30.local.en: Land commissioners in [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_land_petition_state').GetName] have surveyed the countryside under the new law, yet several local military estates still collect rent under the old rules. Farmers who have paid the redemption price are told by their old masters that their fields remain military property and that the dues must be paid. Teachers who helped draft their petitions have been arrested for concealing property.\n\nThe deeds submitted by the affected counties contradict the garrison registers. The provincial governor seeks authority to review the cases, while the commissioners ask the court to send troops to recover the withheld records. As the dispute drags on, farmers gather in the county towns, awaiting an answer from the government that promised to free them.

nesnd_crisis.33.d.zh: 山西的退伍军人、地方士人与失地农户，因清丈后的生计困顿和接连搜捕聚到了一处。共和派借乡校与旧日军中关系传递文书，要求各县推举代表，追究侵夺田产的军官。\n\n几处驻军大营拒绝交出涉案军官，省督派去查问的官员也被挡在营外。各县代表因而要求撤换清丈主官，重审田产并赔补受害农户。共和派已开始联络愿意倒戈的营伍，准备在请愿无门时举兵。刑部将案情呈至朝廷，请求裁定是撤官重审，还是以抗命聚众治罪。
nesnd_crisis.33.d.en: Veterans, local scholars and dispossessed farmers in Shanxi have gathered over the hardship and arrests that followed the land surveys. Republican organisers use village schools and old military connections to circulate petitions, calling on each county to choose delegates and hold officers accountable for the seizure of farmland.\n\nSeveral garrisons refuse to surrender the accused officers and have turned away the governor's investigators. The county delegates demand the removal of the chief commissioner, a fresh review of titles and compensation for the injured farmers. Republican organisers are seeking allies among the troops and preparing to rise if their petitions fail. The Ministry of Justice has referred the case to the court: dismiss the officials and reopen the inquiry, or prosecute the assemblies for defying the law.

nesnd_crisis.31.d.zh: 各地行营开始截留本应解往户部的税款。军官以供饷为名接管关卡、仓廪与地方官署，省督或被迫迁就驻军，或依靠自己的亲军与之争夺财源。清丈官只能在驻军准许的地方办案。欠饷的营伍纷纷向主将索要田产，原有的营兵集团由此取得了更广的地方权力。\n\n兵部奉[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameWithTitle]之命发出的调防令接连退回。元老院中的勋旧要求承认各营与省督已经掌握的兵财之权，以换取各省继续奉朝廷正朔。咨议局送来的地方陈情也已无从逐案办理。朝廷若不能作出让步，失去约束的营兵便可能拥立自己的政府。
nesnd_crisis.31.d.en: Field commands across the Empire are withholding taxes owed to the Ministry of Revenue. Officers seize customs posts, granaries and provincial offices in the name of paying their troops. Governors either yield to the garrisons or use their own loyal units to contest the revenue. Land commissioners can work only where the troops permit them, while unpaid soldiers demand estates from their commanders. The military blocs have acquired powers far beyond their former holdings.\n\nRedeployment orders issued by the Ministry of War in the name of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameWithTitle] are repeatedly returned. Senior members of the Senate demand recognition of the military and fiscal powers already seized by governors and commands in exchange for their continued allegiance. The court can no longer hear the provincial petitions forwarded by the Consultative Council. Without a settlement, commands beyond its control may establish governments of their own.

nesnd_crisis.32.d.zh: 各省请求停止地权改革的文书已经汇集到朝廷。元老院中的勋旧提出一份妥协草案，拟请[ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameWithTitle]颁诏收束这场运动。所谓“新契”确认的土地仍归军户，但须由军户承诺减轻佃租，并准许佃农离乡务工；尚未处置的庄田、军田与宗族产业，则交由省督督办，暂列为“国家公田”，由官府招佃。\n\n这份草案使力主改革的公卿难堪，也将使依靠旧有地权组织起来的地方势力重新参与征税与乡里治理。户部与兵部都希望借此平息各省争端，将有限的财赋与人力收回常政。若予批准，地权革命便将在这些妥协中结束；余下的理想，只能留待后人。
nesnd_crisis.32.d.en: Memorials requesting an end to land reform have reached the court. The senior commanders and ministers of the Senate propose a compromise and ask [ROOT.GetCountry.GetRuler.GetFullNameWithTitle] to close the campaign by decree. Under their draft, land recognised by the new deeds would remain with military households, who must promise lower rents and allow tenants to leave for work. Unsettled estates, military land and lineage property would pass under the governors' supervision as state lands let to tenants.\n\nThe proposal humiliates the ministers who championed reform. It would also restore a place in taxation and village government to the local powers sustained by the old land system. The Ministries of Revenue and War hope to settle the provincial disputes and return scarce funds and officials to ordinary administration. Approval would bring the land revolution to an end on these terms, leaving its remaining ambitions to another generation.
nesnd_crisis.32.d.reason: Preserve author’s military-household ownership, reduced rent, freedom to migrate and state-land compromise as proposed policy. The event appears before the choice, and acceptance permanently ends this campaign.

flavorCNE.6.d.zh: [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_mess_imprisonment_state').GetName]的清丈官员拘捕了一批代写田契诉状的乡民，将他们以串通隐产的罪名交由驻军看押。军官随即扩大搜捕，地方士绅、乡校教员与整理旧契的书吏都被带入营中。\n\n新法赋予官员清理田产的权力，也准许农户为自己的产业提出申诉。囚犯的家属带着田契到省城求告，省督将案情报请刑部查办。负责清丈的官员却以军民勾连、恐生变乱为由，请兵部保护承办军官。若只把涉事官吏调离，营中的追捕便可轻轻揭过；若要追究，清丈官也须为奉行新法时犯下的罪行负责。
flavorCNE.6.d.en: Land commissioners in [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_mess_imprisonment_state').GetName] have arrested villagers who drafted petitions over disputed titles and placed them in military custody for concealing property. Officers widened the arrests to local gentry, teachers and clerks who kept the old deeds.\n\nThe new law empowers officials to settle land ownership, but also permits farmers to defend their property. The prisoners' families have taken their deeds to the provincial capital, and the governor has referred the case to the Ministry of Justice. The commissioners warn of collusion and unrest and ask the Ministry of War to protect the officers involved. Transferring a few officials would allow the affair to pass quietly. A prosecution would make the reform's own agents answer for crimes committed in its name.
flavorCNE.6.d.reason: Give the new prose the actual choice between transfer/impunity and punishment, with governor and ministries instead of generic court referrals. Preserve the author’s options.

flavorCNE.7.d.zh: [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_industrialists_support_state').GetName]的厂主与商人联名呈请，愿意为土地改革垫付一笔款项。工坊正在扩建，商路上的货车日渐增多；他们希望新法能够准许农户自由迁居，将更多劳动力带入城镇。\n\n商人的代表还请求通过咨议局提出土地、道路与雇工契约方面的建议。省督愿意接纳这笔资助，户部官员则认为，这些人有财力，也熟悉实业，可以让他们更多参与政府事务。这批新兴的产业家，希望在帝国政府中取得与其财富相称的位置。
flavorCNE.7.d.en: Manufacturers and merchants in [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_industrialists_support_state').GetName] have jointly offered to finance land reform. Workshops are expanding and more carts travel the commercial roads. They want the new law to allow farming families to move freely and bring more workers into the towns.\n\nTheir representatives also seek to submit proposals on land, roads and employment contracts through the Consultative Council. The governor is willing to accept the funding. Officials in the Ministry of Revenue argue that these wealthy men understand industry and could take a greater part in government. The rising manufacturers hope to gain a position in imperial affairs commensurate with their wealth.
flavorCNE.7.d.reason: Do not imply purchase of a parliamentary seat; retain the author’s support-versus-political-influence choice and specify the advisory channel.

flavorCNE.8.d.zh: [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_peasants_in_city_state').GetName]的街巷里住进了许多来自乡间的新客。农户卖去田产，带着家人寻找工钱；招工的牙行将他们送往厂房和工地，又从每一份工资中扣取引荐与食宿的费用。\n\n一批工人向官府告发牙行私扣契约、追索旧债。厂主担心查办牙行将妨碍招工，地方士绅也替这些与乡党往来密切的经纪说情。省督须决定，是责令官署查办这些束缚雇工的行会，还是将争端仍作普通民事案件处置。农民离开旧田庄以后能否自由谋生，正在这些新生的城镇中受到考验。
flavorCNE.8.d.en: The streets of [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_peasants_in_city_state').GetName] are filling with newcomers from the countryside. Farming families have sold their land and come in search of wages. Employment brokers send them to factories and building sites, deducting recruitment and lodging charges from their pay.\n\nWorkers have accused the brokers of withholding contracts and enforcing old debts. Manufacturers fear that an inquiry will disrupt recruitment, while local gentry defend brokers linked to their own associations. The governor must decide whether to prosecute the organisations that bind workers to them or leave the disputes to ordinary civil proceedings. In these growing towns, the promise that peasants could leave their old estates and freely earn a living faces its first practical tests.
flavorCNE.8.d.reason: Specify governor and connect protected brokers to the actual gang modifiers and industrialist/landowner costs. Avoid docks in randomly chosen inland states.

nesnd_cne_funding.1.d.zh: [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName]的省督呈报，许多离开田庄的乡民尚不熟悉工坊所需的手艺，在城镇中难以谋生。户部据此拟定拨款，供当地兴办实业学堂，并扶助工坊扩建。若能使乡民学会新业，地权改革所许诺的自由便有了生计上的依托。
nesnd_cne_funding.1.d.en: The governor of [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName] reports that many people leaving the estates lack the skills needed by workshops and struggle to find a living in town. The Ministry of Revenue proposes a grant for practical schools and workshop expansion. Learning a new trade would give these families the means to use the freedom promised by land reform.

nesnd_cne_funding.2.d.zh: [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName]的省督请求增拨救济。失去收入的家庭已经开始减少口粮，城内的招工尚不足以安置他们。户部拟在原有救济上加发一年的补助，供这些家庭度过转业的难关，现已呈请批准。
nesnd_cne_funding.2.d.en: The governor of [SCOPE.sState('nesnd_cne_funding_state').GetName] requests additional relief. Families without an income are cutting their meals, and the towns offer too few jobs to support them. The Ministry of Revenue proposes a year of additional payments through the existing relief institutions and has submitted the grant for approval.
nesnd_cne_funding.2.d.reason: Make the fiscal actors concrete and retain the one-year supplement rather than a new welfare institution.

nesnd_cne_camps_journal_reason.zh: 自1444年以来，北明秦藩的军屯逐渐发展为遍及北方的营产制度。军队凭借地产取得粮饷，朝廷借助军队推动征税、扩张与征服，军国与农业的利益由此紧密相连。如今要让田产与矿业转入民用经营，便必须触动军中的旧利。\n\n户部要求各省将营产纳入通常的赋税与经营，兵部则须应付将领对军饷和旧功的索求。省督负责推行新法，手中却未必有足以压服驻军的力量；元老院里的开国勋旧，也不会轻易答应剥去自己的产业。各省可以分别办理，遇到难以收束的争端时再予暂缓。军队失去的地产，终须由新的财政与生产来弥补。
nesnd_cne_camps_journal_reason.en: Since 1444, the Qin military colonies of Northern Ming have developed into an estate system across the north. Land supplied the army's food and pay, while the army sustained taxation and conquest. Military and agricultural interests grew together. Bringing these lands and mines into civilian use now threatens entrenched military privileges.\n\nThe Ministry of Revenue wants the estates brought under ordinary taxation and management. The Ministry of War must answer officers who invoke unpaid wages and past service. Governors charged with enforcing the law may lack the force to compel their garrisons, while the founding commanders in the Senate are reluctant to surrender their own property. The provinces can proceed separately and suspend reform where disputes become unmanageable. New revenue and production must eventually replace the army's landed income.
nesnd_cne_camps_journal_reason.reason: Clarify the ministry/governor/garrison/Senate conflict requested by the author and retain historical origin and individual province pacing.

nesnd_cne_camps_journal_reason.mechanic: 22 separate state programmes; each adds civil production/tax/construction modifiers and cumulative military approval/officer loyalty opposition. No central parliament or universal compliant governors.

nesnd_cne_urban_journal_reason.zh: 乡民离开田庄之后，必须在工坊、矿山与城市中找到新的位置。帝国需要从煤铁到钢铁、工具与机器的连续生产，也需要让劳动者能够承受疾病、失业与衰老。六部所议的实业、学政与救济，到了地方都须由省督筹措、施行。城市扩张所带来的新职业和新学问，也将动摇旧日乡校与士人的权威。
nesnd_cne_urban_journal_reason.en: People leaving the estates need work in workshops, mines and towns. Coal and iron must sustain the production of steel, tools and engines, while relief helps workers endure illness, unemployment and old age. The industrial, educational and welfare measures discussed by the Six Ministries depend on governors to organise and carry them out. The occupations and learning that grow with the cities will also weaken the authority of the old rural schools and scholars.
nesnd_cne_urban_journal_reason.reason: Retain industrial/livelihood theme; concretise execution without inventing a ministry name or parliamentary sovereignty.

nesnd_cne_confidence_journal_reason.zh: 大革命的烽火已经远去，却还照着这一代人的前路。县署中的吏员、营垒里的中下军官与士兵，以及渴望摆脱旧日束缚的农民，仍把地权革命视为当年誓言的延续。\n\n牧仲棠称帝以后，六部掌理政务，元老院中的开国将领与勋旧大臣独掌立法之权。咨议局收集陈情、提出建议，能否施行仍须由掌权者裁定。南方与西北的流亡共和党人将牧仲棠斥作叛国者；在许多支持改革的人心中，牧皇及其同道仍代表着开蒙运动与进步的希望。帝国的政令得以推行，也有赖于这些官员、士兵和农民尚未冷却的热情。一次次清丈、迁业与整营，都在要求他们继续忍耐。
nesnd_cne_confidence_journal_reason.en: The fires of the Great Revolution have faded, but its promises still guide clerks, junior officers, soldiers and peasants seeking release from old obligations. They see the land revolution as the continuation of an unfinished cause.\n\nAfter Mu Zhongtang became emperor, the Six Ministries administered the state, while founding commanders and senior ministers in the Senate monopolised legislative power. The Consultative Council gathers petitions and makes proposals whose fate rests with those who govern. Republican exiles in the south and northwest call Mu a traitor. Many supporters of reform still regard him and his companions as champions of enlightenment and progress. Imperial policy depends on the surviving enthusiasm of these officials, soldiers and farmers. Each new survey, change of occupation and reorganisation of the estates asks them to endure more.
nesnd_cne_confidence_journal_reason.reason: Ground the new confidence JE in the author’s concrete constitutional canon; remove repetitive abstract contrast while preserving divided revolutionary loyalties.
nesnd_cne_confidence_journal_reason.source: common/scripted_effects/nesnd_cne_confidence.txt; common/scripted_triggers/nesnd_cne_confidence.txt; events/nesnd_cne_confidence.txt; Latest author canon: six ministries; Senate of veteran commanders and senior ministers monopolises legislative authority; advisory 咨议局; provincial 省督/总督.
nesnd_cne_confidence_journal_reason.mechanic: Confidence represents public/political endurance, not a legislature variable. No vote or constitutional mechanic is added.

nesnd_cne_confidence.5.war.zh: 内战已经爆发，地方官署与营伍各奉其主。清丈与迁业的命令被军令取代，朝廷再也无法依照原定的章程推行地权革命。
nesnd_cne_confidence.5.war.en: Civil war has broken out. Provincial administrations and armies now answer to rival governments. Military orders have displaced the work of land reform, and the court can no longer carry out the campaign.
nesnd_cne_confidence.5.war.reason: Trigger covers both native revolution and secession war; do not label every secession a revolutionary war.

nesnd_cne_confidence.3.d.zh: 帝国旧政府已经倒下。共和军接收了其州郡与官署，以大汉共和邦之名建立新政府。对于湖南、湖北与四川尚未归本国或其附属统辖的地区，新政府重申了大革命以来统一国家的主张。
nesnd_cne_confidence.3.d.en: The imperial government has fallen. The republicans have taken over its provinces and offices and established the Han Commonwealth. The new government reasserts the revolutionary claim to national unity in those parts of Hunan, Hubei and Sichuan still outside its own rule or that of its subjects.
nesnd_cne_confidence.3.d.reason: Do not introduce an unestablished republican assembly; align claim description with actual subject exclusions.
nesnd_cne_confidence.3.d.mechanic: Claims only for still foreign-controlled state regions; no automatic southern invasion or annexation.

ce_cne_land_reform_reason.zh: 这一运动发源自1810年的西秦大革命。被本时代人视为农业发达而宗族根深蒂固的东方诸国内萌发的一种近代经济上的变革运动。其特点大致可以是用赎买或强制剥夺的手段，将超额聚敛的土地从其旧时代的所有者手中剥夺，平均到部分农民手中。以此打破古代宗族对农村人口的束缚和垄断。中华帝国统治集团在掌权过程中一度中止这一变革。但在1820年的牧仲棠南征前后，为了经济振兴、解放生产和发动底层农民、士兵，牧仲棠及其亲信重新开启了这一运动。
ce_cne_land_reform_reason.en: This movement began with the Western Qin Great Revolution of 1810. People of the age understood it as a modern economic transformation arising among the agrarian states of the East, where powerful lineages had long dominated rural life. Through purchase or compulsory confiscation, land accumulated beyond all measure by its old owners was redistributed among a portion of the peasantry. The aim was to break the lineages’ hold over the rural population. The ruling group of the Empire of China suspended the movement during its rise to power. Around Mu Zhongtang’s southern campaign of 1820, however, he and his confidants revived it to restore the economy, free productive activity and mobilise peasants and soldiers.
ce_cne_land_reform_reason.reason: Keep the mature Chinese original byte-for-byte; replace Chinese fallback in the effective English layer with a faithful translation, without the older English’s invented extra theory.

flavorCNE.3.d.zh:
我们完善的土地法案、雇工法案、民法家庭相关条文已被推行至帝国的每一个角落，建起来一个崭新的经济秩序。在这一秩序中，我们解放了被血亲家族束缚了数千年的人们。高高的田垄回归了它自然资源的本来面目。

随着旧宗族和土地不再能锁住农民，无数稚嫩、满是灰土却充满朝气的脸孔源源不断地从郊野涌入城市。他们憧憬新的生活。一种用人类的智慧和科学力量构建的生活。许多血缘的余孽用各种各样的地方团体伪装自己，试图重新夺回对这些人的控制。但巡捕的警棍和判官的惊堂木终会粉碎他们的野心。

我们又一次将开国帝牧仲棠的理想照进现实。我们证明了这个帝国是为了华夏民族之利益而构建。为此，它将保护哪怕最细小无助者自由选择自己命运的权力——他们如今在城市中追求幸福，给帝国带来新的繁荣。
flavorCNE.3.d.en:
Our revised laws on land, employment and family relations have reached every corner of the Empire and established a new economic order. We have freed people from the bonds of kinship that held them for thousands of years. The fields have returned to their proper place as a natural resource.

As the old lineages and their land can no longer bind the peasantry, young faces, dusty yet full of life, stream from the countryside into the cities. They dream of a new life built through human intelligence and science. The remnants of hereditary power disguise themselves as local associations and try to regain control over them. Police batons and the magistrate’s gavel will break their ambitions.

Once more we have brought the founding emperor Mu Zhongtang’s ideals into reality. We have shown that this Empire was built for the interests of the Huaxia nation. It will protect even the weakest person’s freedom to choose a future. Those now seeking happiness in the cities are bringing new prosperity to the Empire.
